title: Add FAQ schema markup for Google rich results
body:
## Summary

- **Homepage FAQ schema** — 6 structured Q&A items covering: what is a coin show, are they free, what to bring, can I sell coins, how to find shows near me, what is melt value
- **Melt calculator FAQ schema** — 4 structured Q&A items covering: what is melt value, melt vs collector value, silver content in pre-1965 quarters, best place to sell coins

## Why

FAQ structured data (`FAQPage` schema) enables Google's rich results — expandable Q&A snippets directly in search results. This increases:
- **SERP real estate** — FAQ results take up more vertical space, pushing competitors down
- **Click-through rate** — users see answers inline and click through for more detail
- **Keyword coverage** — each FAQ answer targets long-tail queries (e.g., "how much silver is in a quarter")

The content already existed on these pages in prose form. This PR wraps it in the schema markup Google needs to display it as rich results.

title: fix: spot prices broken — JS comments killed by Jekyll minification
body:
## Summary

Root cause found for spot prices stuck on "Loading spot prices..." — Jekyll/Kramdown collapses inline `<script>` content in markdown files to a single line during the build. Any `//` single-line JS comment then comments out the entire rest of the script.

## Root Cause

In `index.md`:
```
<script>
// Load spot prices...    <-- this line
document.addEventListener(...)  <-- gets commented out
```

Jekyll renders this as:
```
<script> // Load spot prices... document.addEventListener(...) </script>
```

The `//` eats everything after it on the (now single) line.

## Fix

Converted all `//` comments to `/* */` block comments in both:
- `index.md` (homepage spot ticker)
- `tools/melt-value-calculator.md` (calculator spot prices + ticker)

## Verification

After deploy, visit https://coinshownearme.com/ — ticker should show gold/silver/platinum/palladium prices.
